Exact original Arabic input is retained; two explicit corrections at 499 and 511 have both printed readings and visible source notices. All prior 498 entry objects remain unchanged. The opening Arabic chapter quotation remains separately browseable outside numbered sessions and narration, with English pending. Independent Arabic, English, lexical, chapter, reference and spoken-word review remain pending. This is not production approval.
